component.name: templates
component.description: TAPPaaS module templates: generated from templates-components.json; do not edit.

ratings.justification: other: HTTP/2 upload use-after-free when the server resets the stream (curl 8.21.0 to 8.22.0, fixed in 8.23.0). Needs a request with a body over HTTPS/HTTP2 to a malicious or compromised server. The base's libcurl users (git, nix, systemd, NetworkManager, elfutils, tpm2-tss) and TAPPaaS's curl calls upload only to TAPPaaS's own services and to the code forges over TLS. Fix: curl 8.23.0, in staging-next-26.05, not yet on the nixos-26.05 channel.

templates/nix:glibc. gettext loads a catalog from a LANGUAGE value containing / or ..; it needs an attacker who sets LANGUAGE for a program running with other rights and without AT_SECURE. On the guests nobody outside can: sshd accepts no client environment (AcceptEnv unset, forgejo only GIT_PROTOCOL; PermitUserEnvironment no; checked on all NixOS guests on hrossen 2026-11-07), services get fixed systemd environments, and sudo is setuid (AT_SECURE). Admins who log in already run code as themselves. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.
templates/nix:gnutls. In certtool's template parsing; certtool is not run on guests. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

templates/nix:gnutls. A TLS server's PSK handshake; only NetworkManager loads gnutls on a guest, as a client, and no guest serves TLS through gnutls. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.
templates/nix:gnutls. DTLS handshake reassembly; nothing on a guest speaks DTLS through gnutls. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

templates/nix:gnutls. nameConstraints in X.509 path validation through gnutls; the only gnutls user on a guest (NetworkManager) does no such validation for TAPPaaS (wired, no 802.1X). Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.
templates/nix:gnutls. DTLS packet reordering; nothing on a guest speaks DTLS through gnutls. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.
templates/nix:gnutls. A TLS server with RSA-PSK; no guest serves TLS through gnutls. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

templates/nix:libcap. A TOCTOU in cap_set_file needing a local user with write access to the parent directory; only root runs setcap, at activation. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-11-12.

templates/nix:libressl. Memory exhaustion in LibreSSL's ocspcheck tool from a malicious OCSP responder; ocspcheck is not on any guest's PATH, nothing runs it, and no running process maps libressl (checked on all NixOS guests on hrossen 2026-11-07). Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

templates/nix:libssh2. Needs the client to connect to a malicious SSH server; libssh2's users on a guest (NetworkManager, nix-daemon) open no SSH connections (nix fetches over HTTPS). Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

templates/nix:openssh. Trojaned Red Hat Enterprise Linux 4/5 OpenSSH packages signed in August 2008; matched by product name only. NixOS builds upstream OpenSSH. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

templates/nix:openssh. Rowhammer flip of the authenticated flag in mm_answer_authpassword (disputed upstream), the PasswordAuthentication path; every NixOS guest runs sshd with PasswordAuthentication no, and no account has a usable password hash, so keyboard-interactive/PAM cannot authenticate by password either (sshd -T and /etc/shadow checked on all 19 NixOS guests on hrossen 2026-11-07). Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

templates/nix:openssh. sshd keeping GSSAPI credentials after a failed GSSAPIAuthentication attempt. nixpkgs builds openssh without Kerberos (withKerberos = false: no --with-kerberos5, no krb5 in its closure), so sshd has no GSSAPI authentication at all: sshd -T lists no GSSAPI option. Every NixOS guest and the mothership run that one build (43zp0r...-openssh-10.5p1). Fixed upstream in OpenSSH 10.6. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

templates/nix:openssh. sshd keeping GSSAPI authentication state across attempts. nixpkgs builds openssh without Kerberos (withKerberos = false: no --with-kerberos5, no krb5 in its closure), so sshd has no GSSAPI authentication at all: sshd -T lists no GSSAPI option. Every NixOS guest and the mothership run that one build (43zp0r...-openssh-10.5p1). Fixed upstream in OpenSSH 10.6. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

templates/nix:openssh. ssh client: a $ or \ in a command-line username is injected where %r/%u is expanded into a shell-run directive (ProxyCommand, LocalCommand, Match exec). The guests' ssh_config has only systemd's ssh proxy, whose ProxyCommand uses %h and %p, the operator's ~/.ssh/config none, and TAPPaaS calls ssh with fixed user names (tappaas, root). Fixed upstream in OpenSSH 10.6. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

templates/nix:openssh. Affects the GSSAPI patch some Linux distributions add, not upstream OpenSSH; nixpkgs' default openssh carries no GSSAPI patch, and GSSAPI authentication is off. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

templates/nix:perl. Regexes with more than 65535 alternation branches; perl on a guest runs only NixOS's own scripts, with no attacker-supplied pattern. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.
templates/nix:perl. pack/unpack templates from an attacker; perl on a guest runs only NixOS's own scripts. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.
templates/nix:perl. Regex compilation on 32-bit builds; guests are x86_64 and run only NixOS's own perl scripts. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

templates/nix:rsync. Sender-side hash_search DoS by a malicious receiver pulling from a public rsync daemon module; no guest runs an rsync daemon (nothing listens on 873, checked on all NixOS guests on hrossen 2026-11-07), and rsync over ssh only runs between TAPPaaS hosts. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.
templates/nix:sqlite. A crafted FTS5 database supplied by an attacker; sqlite on a guest opens only nix's own root-owned database. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.
templates/nix:sqlite. A crafted FTS5 database supplied by an attacker; sqlite on a guest opens only nix's own root-owned database. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

templates/nix:sqlite. The sqlite3 command-line shell's .recover output carries shell instructions from a crafted schema; only an admin running .recover by hand on such a file and feeding the output back into the shell reaches it, and no unit or script on the guests runs .recover. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

templates/nix:util-linux. Non-root mount(8) TOCTOU, reachable only through an /etc/fstab entry with the user or users option; no guest's fstab has one (checked on all 19 NixOS guests on hrossen 2026-11-07) and no module declares one. 2.42.4 also closes it except for the legacy mount(2) path without /proc, which no guest uses. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.
